title: Quadratic value after a coordinate repair
statement: Let $n\ge 2$ and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Form a vector $y$ as follows: if the complete quadratic bit of $x$ is $1$, set $y=x$; otherwise, if some coordinate has derivative bit $1$, flip one such coordinate; if no such coordinate exists, flip coordinates $0$ and $1$. Then the complete quadratic bit of $y$ is $1$.
